obfuscation_indicators: unable to predict extent or nature
risk_summary: The disclosure is relatively precise and well quantified, reporting sales, margins, restructuring costs, impairments, gains, and profitability changes. Risk remains elevated due to pandemic uncertainty, supply-chain constraints, inflationary materials costs, labor shortages, customer bankruptcy exposure, facility exits, and prior-year impairments, although fiscal 2021 results show a meaningful recovery.
